params.code:
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
import os

img = Image.new('RGB', (400, 600), (240, 240, 240))
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# 脸
draw.ellipse([100, 80, 300, 320], fill=(255, 230, 210))

# 左眼（浅蓝瞳孔）
draw.ellipse([160, 180, 190, 210], fill=(255,255,255))
draw.ellipse([165, 185, 185, 205], fill=(173,216,230))
draw.ellipse([175, 190, 182, 197], fill=(0,0,0))

# 嘴巴弧线
draw.arc([180, 260, 220, 280], start=0, end=180, fill=(200,0,0), width=3)

# 天蓝色头发（椭圆+多边形）
draw.ellipse([80, 50, 320, 160], fill=(135,206,250))
draw.polygon([(100,80), (200,100), (300,80), (320,150), (80,150)], fill=(135,206,250))
draw.polygon([(180,80), (300,80), (290,160), (170,150)], fill=(135,206,250))

# 女仆装
draw.rectangle([100, 320, 300, 450], fill=(255,255,255))
draw.rectangle([100, 450, 300, 580], fill=(0,0,139))
draw.rectangle([140, 340, 260, 480], fill=(255,255,255), outline=(200,200,200))
draw.polygon([(180,320), (220,320), (200,340)], fill=(255,0,0))

output_dir = r'C:\Users\hp\Desktop\claude\agent\output'
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
img.save(os.path.join(output_dir, 'rem_portrait_by_learn.png'))
print('图片已保存')
